dct_description_sm: This study is a part of the Canadian International Polar Year (IPY) project 'Climate Change Impacts on Canadian Arctic Tundra Ecosystems (CiCAT): Interdisciplinary and Multi-scale Assessments'. The direct objective of this study was to monitor and assess the impacts of climate change on ecological integrity of arctic national parks (e.g., Torngat Mountain National Park Reserve), in collaboration with Parks Canada Agency. The information may also be used for regional wildlife habitat assessment and global carbon cycle studies.
dct_title_s: Field measurements of vegetation in the Torngat Mountain National Park Reserve
